obligatory_conditions.description: Personal and geographical proper names as direct object
Independent personal pronouns as direct object
Demonstrative determiners (این / آن) modifying direct object
obligatory_conditions.example: این کتاب را خواندم (I read this book)

obligatory_conditions.description: Nouns with possessive enclitics or possessive Ezafe
obligatory_conditions.example: کتابم را آوردم (I brought my book) / کتابِ علی را بردم (I took Ali's book)

prohibited_conditions.description: Bare nouns functioning as generic direct objects incorporated into verb
prohibited_conditions.example: سیب خوردم (I ate apple/apples) vs *سیب را خوردم (when indefinite)

prohibited_conditions.description: Subjects of intransitive or transitive verbs

optional_specific_conditions.description: Noun marked with indefinite -i indicating a specific referent known to speaker
optional_specific_conditions.example: کتابی را خریدم که دیروز دیدیم (I bought a [specific] book that we saw yesterday)
